central_idea_and_construction: Exactly LUMA, four custom rounded uppercase letters with a warm, confidently drawn 1970s editorial spirit. Use moderately wide letter bodies and a shared smooth flared terminal family. L ends in a gentle upward curl, U has a deep broad bowl, M has two generous rounded shoulders with an open central notch, A has an arched outside and one unmistakable large interior counter and crossbar. Keep the letter skeletons familiar while the soft flared rhythm is distinctive. Each letter is one flat color. Quietly varied widths and carefully balanced white intervals, all on a calm baseline. Center the horizontal word at 78% canvas width. No supporting icon.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Flared soft feet and open U/M/A spaces.
specific_risk: A can lose its counter or M can look like an n if over-rounded.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
